about_the_game: The demo includes a single level from the game, allowing you to explore the dreamlike world of Overlook Trail. In this demo, you take flight on a wind-swept leaf, soaring through a moonlit landscape. As you navigate, you'll dodge obstacles and collect glowing orbs that hint at the game's deeper mechanics. This brief experience captures the essence of the game's tranquil yet adventurous tone, combining arcade-like flight controls with a dreamy visual style.
